_:
repo ~/i/ed is 54, a design and software studio, live at https://54.apexlinks.org. ed.apexlinks.org and ed.apexlinks.workers.dev 301 there. push to main deploys (workers builds: pnpm run build, then pnpm exec wrangler deploy).
stack: sveltekit (next), svelte 5 runes only, tailwind 4 (tokens in the @theme of src/routes/layout.css), adapter-cloudflare workers, pnpm 11, node 24.
goal: the site shows websites, apps and software as clearly as design.
settled, never revisit:
- software lives in the same `work` list in src/lib/design.ts as design, kind 'app'. one wall, one lightbox, one piece page.
- data.g (visitor in nigeria) changes only currency and main contact (whatsapp vs email). never the offer or the order.
- every user-facing string comes verbatim from plan/studio-deck.md. never write copy. all lowercase, no emoji, ’ for apostrophes.
- images: static/work/{s}-{n}.webp slides, {s}-t.webp 960w thumb.
files: src/lib/design.ts (piece type, work, kinds, prices, money), src/lib/data.ts (p = contact), src/routes/+page.svelte (home), src/routes/+page.server.ts (data.g), src/routes/+layout.svelte, src/lib/components/Lightbox.svelte, src/hooks.server.ts, src/routes/layout.css.
code rules: snake_case. single-letter keys for data, types, json and load returns, each commented at its definition. no comments except a non-obvious why. no single-use variables. tailwind utilities and the existing classes (pill pill-gold pill-ghost chip card tile tile-img); no new css file, no inline style=, no raw hex outside the @theme. pnpm only, never npm or npx.
traps: pnpm check runs wrangler types --check and fails on a fresh tree, so gates run svelte-check then build. a dev server may run: ss -ltnp | grep 9270; reuse it, else pnpm dev; it listens on [::1], use http://localhost:9270. /?c=ng and /?c=us preview each country. look with ab-1440fl --session studio --pin-tab (headless); screenshots to ~/.local/state/54-studio/. e2e (testerarmy) docs: node_modules/e2e/docs.
never stage .log, .dev-logs/server.log or static/macro/ (unrelated). stash@{0} is an old pivot Ed set aside: never pop, apply or drop it.
after each mark: commit only the step's files plus plan/studio.plan.json, plan/studio.log, plan/studio.notes.md. message `<feat|fix|chore>(studio): <imperative, lowercase, max 50>`, blank line, `- ` bullets, trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. then git push: push deploys to production.

base.s: the site renders everywhere, and the repo tells the truth

render_everywhere.s:
the site renders for every visitor and on every host.
1. src/lib/actions/reveal.ts: under reduced motion, `reveal` returns at once. nothing is hidden in that mode, and the old branch passed '> *' raw to querySelectorAll, which threw and made the live page a 500 for every visitor with reduce motion on.
2. src/hooks.server.ts: 301 only GET/HEAD on the old hosts ed.apexlinks.org and ed.apexlinks.workers.dev, path and query kept. every other host passes, so localhost, wrangler preview and preview urls render.
3. src/hooks.server.spec.ts: add 'leaves localhost alone' (http://localhost:9270/) and 'leaves a preview url alone' (https://abc123-ed.apexlinks.workers.dev/), both 200.
look: http://localhost:9270/?c=us with ab-1440fl after `set media dark reduced-motion` shows the h1, not a 500.
render_everywhere.t: grep -qF 'if (usesReducedMotion()) return;' src/lib/actions/reveal.ts && ! grep -qF 'querySelectorAll(opts.selector)' src/lib/actions/reveal.ts && grep -qF 'ed.apexlinks.workers.dev' src/hooks.server.ts && grep -qF 'localhost' src/hooks.server.spec.ts && pnpm exec vitest run --project server && rm -rf .svelte-kit/output .svelte-kit/cloudflare .svelte-kit/cloudflare-tmp && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error && pnpm build

smoke.s:
a deterministic smoke suite (testerarmy e2e, no agent steps, no model) guards every later step.
1. pnpm add -D e2e@^0.17.0 @e2e-dev/web@^0.12.0. remove @playwright/test and playwright.config.ts.
2. e2e.config.ts: targets desktop web({ viewport 1440x900 }) and phone web({ viewport 390x844 }), both app { url 'http://localhost:4173', command { executable 'pnpm', args ['preview'], reuseExisting false, startupTimeout 120000, log '.e2e/logs/app.log' } }.
3. tests/site.e2e.ts: for /?c=us and /?c=ng, each with motion and with reduced motion (an init script makes matchMedia report true for 'prefers-reduced-motion', with no-op listener methods): the h1 is visible, 'Internal Error' never appears, #work has at least 10 .tile, and document scrollWidth <= innerWidth. structure only, never copy.
4. package.json: test:e2e = 'pnpm build && e2e run', test = 'pnpm test:unit --run && pnpm test:e2e'. .gitignore gets .e2e/.
smoke.t: test -f e2e.config.ts && test -f tests/site.e2e.ts && test ! -f playwright.config.ts && ! grep -qF 'npm run' package.json && rm -rf .svelte-kit/output .svelte-kit/cloudflare .svelte-kit/cloudflare-tmp && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error && pnpm build && pnpm exec e2e run
